    Company Description

    About Bosch Service Solutions in Timisoara

    Bosch Service Solutions is a leading service provider of enterprise and IT solutions. It designs and provides best-in-class services, including software-based solutions, consulting and management, AI, automation and customer experience. We're on a mission to exceed customer expectations and continually elevate industry standards. Our colleagues contribute to this mission through their commitment, in an environment where diversity is valued and where everyone can bring their own contribution.

    Our promise to our colleagues is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work and inspire each other. Join us and see the difference.

    Work LikeABosch

    Qualifications

    • Exceptional Python Proficiency: Fluent in Python with extensive hands-on experience in developing complex applications, scripts, and production-grade systems.
    • Deep AI Understanding: Solid understanding of Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and the architecture of AI systems. Practical experience with AI agents, conversational AI, or generative AI models is a significant advantage.
    • Google Cloud Platform Expertise: Proven experience in developing and deploying applications on GCP, specifically with Google Cloud Functions, Google App Engine, Pub/Sub, Firestore/Cloud SQL, and relevant AI services (e.g., Vertex AI, Dialogflow, Gen AI APIs).
    • API Development Acumen: Experienced in designing, developing, and managing RESTful APIs, with a strong grasp of API design principles, security, and versioning.
    • Cloud Functions Specialist: Practical experience in implementing, deploying, and managing serverless functions is essential.
    • Strong Entrepreneurial Mindset: You think and act like an entrepreneur, are solution-oriented, identify opportunities, and are willing to take calculated risks to realize innovative ideas.
    • Proactive and Results-Driven Mindset: A self-starter who actively embraces challenges, demonstrates initiative, and consistently delivers tangible results.
    • Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to clearly and persuasively communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
    • Team Player: Thrives in a collaborative, interdisciplinary team environment and actively contributes to collective success.

    Job Description

    We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary individual to join us as a AI & Cloud Development Engineer.

    In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in spearheading the introduction, development, and robust establishment of Google AgentSpace within the Bosch Group. You will be the driving force behind the creation and implementation of cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that optimize our processes and enable new business models. This position demands not only outstanding technical expertise but also a strong entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to think innovatively beyond conventional boundaries.

    Your Responsibilities:

    • Strategic Integration: You will play a leading role in conceptualizing and implementing the strategy for integrating Google AgentSpace into Bosch's existing IT infrastructure and application landscape.
    • Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and implement scalable AI applications and services leveraging Google Cloud Functions, Google AgentSpace APIs, and other relevant Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
    • Python Expertise: Utilize your deep proficiency in Python to build robust and efficient backend systems, AI models, and data pipelines.
    • API Development & Integration: Be responsible for developing and deploying high-performance APIs, ensuring seamless integration with internal and external systems.
    • AI Model Implementation: Collaborate closely with Data Scientists to transition AI models into production-ready applications and optimize their performance.
    • Cloud Operations & MLOps: Ensure the smooth operation, scalability, and maintainability of developed solutions, adhering to best practices for cloud infrastructure, MLOps, and DevOps.
    • Mentoring & Knowledge Transfer: Actively share your expertise with colleagues, contributing to the establishment of an internal center of excellence for Google AgentSpace and AI.
    • Proactive Innovation: Independently identify new use cases and potentials for Google AgentSpace within the Bosch Group and drive their implementation.
